title: What a flame needs
note: Approved narration (tools/videos/DESIGN.md). Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); approved by AlanziM2. Editing a recorded script costs ElevenLabs credits.

sentences.say: Every fire, from a candle to a spacecraft emergency, needs three things at once: fuel, oxygen, and heat.
sentences.show: Every fire, from a candle to a spacecraft emergency, needs three things at once: fuel, oxygen, and heat.

sentences.say: Take any one of them away, and the fire goes out.
sentences.show: Take any one of them away, and the fire goes out.

sentences.say: That simple triangle is the basis of fire safety: prevent, detect, and suppress.
sentences.show: That simple triangle is the basis of fire safety: prevent, detect, and suppress.

sentences.say: Most fires in a cabin are diffusion flames.
sentences.show: Most fires in a cabin are diffusion flames.

sentences.say: Fuel and oxygen start apart, and they only burn where they meet, in a thin glowing layer.
sentences.show: Fuel and oxygen start apart, and they only burn where they meet, in a thin glowing layer.

sentences.say: Every fuel uses a fixed amount of oxygen. One molecule of propane needs five molecules of oxygen to burn completely.
sentences.show: Every fuel uses a fixed amount of oxygen. One molecule of propane needs five molecules of oxygen to burn completely.

sentences.say: If the oxygen near the flame runs low, the burning slows down.
sentences.show: If the oxygen near the flame runs low, the burning slows down.

sentences.say: NASA has tested three kinds of fuel in microgravity: gases, liquid droplets, and solids.
sentences.show: NASA has tested three kinds of fuel in microgravity: gases, liquid droplets, and solids.

sentences.say: This database holds 660 gas flame tests, 353 droplet tests, and 263 tests of solid materials.
sentences.show: This database holds 660 gas flame tests, 353 droplet tests, and 263 tests of solid materials.

sentences.say: Solids matter most, because a spacecraft is full of them: fabric, plastic, and wiring.
sentences.show: Solids matter most, because a spacecraft is full of them: fabric, plastic, and wiring.
